summary: Document Lite as the PLATE Copilot review effort default and warn via health/adopt when GitHub exposes a non-Lite repository setting (#1095).
migration_impact: Adopters should set repository Copilot code review Review effort level to Lite. Run gh plate health or gh plate adopt --json after upgrade; follow manual verification when the GitHub API cannot read the setting.
migration_guidance: 1. Repository Settings → Copilot → Code review → set Review effort level to Lite.
2. Run gh plate health --json and confirm copilot_review_effort_status is ok (or complete the manual step in next_step).
3. For risk:high or risk:critical PRs, request Balanced per review when deeper analysis is warranted.
agent_notes: GitHub default effort is Balanced; PLATE cost policy prefers Lite at repo/org level. probe_repository_review_effort tries preview configuration endpoints; when unreadable, health/adopt emit manual verification steps without failing core adoption.
